items.title: Sammy tells West Indies Test stars to attract better pay with better play

items.title: Simmons brushes aside talk of 'chaos' in Bangladesh camp ahead of WI Tests
items.summary: He insisted that the team remained focused following the removal of batting coach Mohammad Ashraful

items.title: ‘Is this the first time there's chaos before a match?’
items.summary: Having witnessed three changes in the Bangladesh Cricket Board's presidency in a relatively short period, Simmons hardly seemed taken aback when asked about the turbulence surrounding the Tigers ahead of their crucial two-match Test series against West Indies, part of the World Test Championship (WTC).

items.title: ‘Definitely not like last year’: Sammy laughs off memories of Mirpur’s black wickets
items.summary: With the West Indies set to begin a two-match Test series against Bangladesh on October 28 at the Sher-e-Bangla National Stadium in Mirpur, Sammy was asked whether the wickets looked anything like those from the previous visit.

items.title: Mustafizur seeks BCB clearance for BBL debut

items.title: Maternity blind spot in Bangladesh cricket
items.summary: When former Bangladesh pacer Suraiya Azmin emailed Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on May 9 to request paid maternity leave, she received no response.

items.title: Ashraful no longer Bangladesh's batting coach
